name: Distant Two-Vertex-Deleted Cube Contraction Obstructions
definition: $\mathcal S_{d,t}=2^{[d]}\setminus\{\varnothing,[t]\}$; thus two cube vertices at Hamming distance $t$ are deleted.
parameters: $d\ge3$ and $3\le t\le d$. It has $2^d-2$ states and isometric dimension $d$.
canonical_form: Cube automorphisms make the distance $t$ between the two deleted vertices the only parameter.
recognition: A deleted-pair certificate records two absent vertices at distance at least three. Projection along every coordinate restores a full $(d-1)$-cube.
comments: Every member is contraction-minimal outside learning-space graphs. The member $\mathcal S_{3,3}$ is $C_6$, while $\mathcal S_{4,3}$ and $\mathcal S_{4,4}=Q_4^{--}$ are the two fourteen-vertex dimension-four representatives.
